fix: You set up the final screen and never show it. Either show the app screen in the last 3 seconds or drop the implied result entirely, and bin the 'not an ad' overlay, that line is the single biggest tell that it is an ad.

The hook is a face in bed with a capsule, visually identical to every supplement video. Open on the phone or a written day-by-day list with days 4 to 7 all reading 'nothing', so the visible stake is failure, and soften the day 8 to 10 claim to something you can honestly say rather than a clean three-night result.

Reason three is the whole video, so tease it in the first 1.5s instead of counting in. Lead with 'reason three is going to annoy you' over the three fingers, then run one, two, three, and cut the product spec line down to a single overlay so the middle never flattens.
